documents.name: CommerceIQ Copilot for Amazon - Product Hub August 25 Internal
documents.detailedDescription: The CommerceIQ Copilot for Amazon - Product Hub August 25 Internal document is a comprehensive guide designed to enhance the productivity of Ecommerce leaders by providing a unified view of their Amazon business. It features AI-driven recommendations and powerful automations to optimize media spend, content, and merchandising. Key components include the AllyAI Sales Teammate, which reduces the time spent on report generation, and the CommerceIQ Copilot Quick Start Guide, which offers foundational knowledge and links to tutorials and videos. The document also outlines the product's pricing template as of August 8, 2025, and includes internal training materials and messaging frameworks to support sales and marketing efforts.
documents.targetAudience: Ecommerce leaders, Sales and Marketing teams

documents.name: Product Success Plan + Training Deck Internal WIP
documents.detailedDescription: The Product Success Plan + Training Deck Internal WIP is a comprehensive internal document designed to guide sales and product success teams through the collaborative selling process of the Success Plan+. It outlines the roles and responsibilities of the Sales and Product Success teams in various stages such as Prospecting, Solutioning, and Customer Engagement. Key features include ExpertIQ Insights & Advisory, which provides advanced analytics and advisory services, and Success Plan+ packages that focus on team enablement through training and workshops. The document also details the use of collateral and sales tools, and the process for customer onboarding and engagement.

documents.name: AllyAI Product Hub
documents.detailedDescription: The AllyAI Product Hub is a comprehensive internal resource designed to equip sales and customer success teams with the necessary tools to effectively market and sell AllyAI's suite of AI-powered teammates. It includes detailed training materials, internal recordings, and presentation decks for Teammate I and II, focusing on enhancing sales performance and media optimization. Key features include the 'Goal Optimization for iROAS' and 'Gap to Plan Recommendations' for Teammate II, as well as 'Embedded Insights' and '1-click Exec. Reports' for Teammate I. The document also outlines the rollout plans for Sales Teammate II and the upcoming general availability for major retailers like Walmart and Target.
doesSupport: training and rollout for AI teammates

documents.name: 8/3 Ally 2 Training Deckv2
documents.detailedDescription: The '8/3 Ally 2 Training Deckv2' is a comprehensive training material designed to equip sales teams with the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively utilize the Ally AI Sales Teammate II. This document outlines the general availability, commercialization strategies, and detailed functionalities of the Ally AI platform, emphasizing its capabilities in sales optimization through AI and automation. Key features include root cause analysis, embedded insights, and 1-click executive reports, which are crucial for making data-driven decisions in a fast-paced retail environment. The training deck also highlights the integration with Amazon Copilot and provides a structured approach to implementing the Ally AI Sales Teammate II, ensuring users can achieve results within 30 days.
documents.targetAudience: Sales teams, Retail managers, E-commerce strategists

documents.name: ExpertIQ Training Deck Internal
documents.detailedDescription: The ExpertIQ Training Deck Internal is a comprehensive internal training document designed to familiarize sales and customer success teams with the ExpertIQ product suite. It provides detailed insights into the product's capabilities, including tactical upsells and strategic value capture through ExpertIQ Insights & Advisory. Key features include AllyAI 1-click reports and deeper advisory insights, with a focus on enabling service stickiness and maximizing client investment through a structured discovery and briefing process. The document also outlines the sales process, collateral usage, and customer onboarding strategies, emphasizing the importance of understanding client objectives and aligning them with business needs.

documents.name: DRAFT CommerceIQ Sales Agent - Product Box January 26 Internal
documents.detailedDescription: The CommerceIQ Sales Agent - Product Box is an internal draft document effective January 2026, designed to provide a comprehensive service description for a tool that enhances strategic, tailored, and measurable outcomes. It leverages deep insights and data across various countries and retailers to create compelling, customer-branded PowerPoint presentations with clear, measurable Recommended Actions aimed at improving CARS metrics (Content, Availability, Ratings & Reviews, Share of Search). The document includes Retailer Access Instructions for logging into customer accounts and navigating through the platform. It emphasizes the importance of checking for the latest version as the information is subject to periodic revisions.
metrics: CARS (Content, Availability, Ratings & Reviews, Share of Search)

documents.name: Ally I Teammate Training
documents.detailedDescription: The 'Ally I Teammate Training' document is a comprehensive guide designed to equip sales teammates with the necessary tools and strategies for effective customer engagement and product renewal processes. It includes detailed sections on the Ally Upgrade Program for July 2025, renewal pricing strategies for the second half of 2025, and a centralized resource hub called the Ally Product Hub in Seismic. This hub provides access to internal trainings, messaging frameworks, and external communication materials like 1-pagers. The document emphasizes the importance of strategic renewal strategies and offers a structured approach to accessing and utilizing product information effectively.
specificKeywords: Renewal Strategy for Teammates I & II

documents.name: Content Agent_Product Box_WIP
documents.detailedDescription: The Content Agent_Product Box is an internal, work-in-progress document designed to enhance product visibility in conversational shopping environments by optimizing Product Detail Page (PDP) content for AI-driven platforms like Amazon Rufus and Walmart Sparky. It provides a self-service interface for training the content agent using natural language inputs, allowing for the integration of brand guidelines and historical data. Key features include Content Validation, which connects Digital Asset Management (DAM), Product Information Management (PIM), and PDPs to ensure content accuracy and completeness, and Content Compliance, which identifies discrepancies and flags incomplete fields. The document emphasizes the importance of maintaining current and accurate product information to improve AI-generated responses.
doesSupport: Aligning PDP content with AI platforms
Training content agents with brand guidelines

documents.name: Content Agent Training Deck
documents.detailedDescription: The Content Agent Training Deck is a comprehensive guide designed to educate users on the deployment and utilization of Retail AI Agents, specifically focusing on the Content Agent. It outlines the vision for automating retail workflows, addressing market challenges such as margin pressures and manual processes, and highlights the integration of AI to enhance compliance and content optimization. Key features include the ability to optimize Product Detail Page (PDP) indexing based on retailer guidelines and a self-service interface for training the content agent with brand-specific context. The document also details a customer go-to-market schedule with specific email campaigns and deployment timelines, aiming for 100% deployment among DSO & Copilot customers by Q1 2026.
documents.targetAudience: Sales teams, Retail brand managers, AI deployment specialists

documents.name: AllyAI Media Teammate
documents.detailedDescription: The AllyAI Media Teammate document is a comprehensive product guide detailing an AI-driven tool designed to enhance media and sales operations for retailers. It highlights the CommerceIQ AI Model, which has undergone over 100k hours of training across 1400 retailers, focusing on root cause analysis and goal optimization for iROAS (incremental Return on Ad Spend). Key features include embedded insights, 1-click executive reports, and gap-to-plan recommendations, all aimed at providing actionable insights and streamlined reporting for sales and media teams. The document emphasizes the tool's ability to deliver tailored insights and recommendations, but does not mention support for non-retail sectors or non-AI-driven analytics.
